en_title: ‘Vice City’ Trademark Abandoned by WWE ahead of GTA 6 launch
subtitle: 申请一个多月后作废
opus_summary: WWE曾申请注册「Vice City」商标，但申请一个多月后便告作废。此举可能与摔角手Lola Vice有关，WWE放弃申请的原因尚不清楚；「罪恶都市」也是《GTA6》的游戏舞台。

paragraphs.en: It appears that WWE was trying to trademark the term ‘Vice City,’ before abandoning plans to do so.
paragraphs.cn: WWE似乎曾试图将「Vice City」注册为商标，但后来放弃了这一计划。

paragraphs.en: According to a trademark filing , the initial application was made on August 8, before being deemed “dead’ just over a month later, on September 21.
paragraphs.cn: 商标申请文件显示，WWE于8月8日提交申请；仅过了一个多月，申请便在9月21日被标记为「失效」。

paragraphs.en: No, it doesn’t appear that WWE was attempting to make its own Grand Theft Auto game, but it was more than likely an attempt to theme something around Lola Vice, a WWE wrestler who has recently been promoted to the main roster. It’s not just her in-ring name that suggests this was the case either, but also the fact that she is from Miami, Florida, the real-life location GTA’s Vice City is based on.
paragraphs.cn: WWE似乎并不是想制作自己的《侠盗猎车手》游戏。更有可能的是，它打算围绕最近升入主节目阵容的摔角手Lola Vice推出某种主题内容。让人产生这种猜测的不只是她的擂台名：她还来自佛罗里达州迈阿密，而这座城市正是《GTA》中罪恶都市的现实原型。

paragraphs.en: While we don’t know the reasons as to why the trademark was abandoned by WWE, it’s fair to speculate that Rockstar Games wouldn’t have taken kindly to someone else trying to claim ownership over a name it has used for over two decades. Vice City is, of course, the setting of the PS2 classic GTA Vice City and the upcoming GTA 6. You’d have to imagine Triple H and co. knew this, but still tried their arm anyway.
paragraphs.cn: 我们不知道WWE为何放弃这项商标申请，但不难猜测：Rockstar用了二十多年的名字，若有人试图将其据为己有，Rockstar恐怕不会乐意。罪恶都市既是PS2经典游戏《GTA：罪恶都市》的舞台，也是即将推出的《GTA6》的舞台。很难想象Triple H等人不知道这一点，但他们还是决定试一试。

paragraphs.en: The extent to which Rockstar is reminding people of this can be seen in real-life Miami now, with nearly $1 million spent on ‘Welcome to Vice City’ signage .
paragraphs.cn: 如今在现实中的迈阿密，就能看到Rockstar如何提醒人们罪恶都市与《GTA》的联系：它花了近100万美元(约合人民币671万元)，设置写有「欢迎来到罪恶都市」的标牌。

paragraphs.en: Incidentally, backyard wrestling looks set to be one of the many, many activities available for Jason and Lucia to engage with in GTA 6, with even a nod to John Cena’s Attitude Adjustment finisher spotted in the recent extended look at the game. You can check out that and 99 details we spotted in our first look at gameplay here .
paragraphs.cn: 顺带一提，在《GTA6》中，后院摔角似乎将是Jason和Lucia可以参与的众多活动之一。最近公开的加长版游戏画面里，甚至还出现了致敬John Cena终结技「态度调整」的动作。这处细节和我们在首次实机画面中发现的另外99处细节，都可以在这里查看。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 is seemingly set to take over the world when it launches on November 19, and the world of sports and entertainment won’t be unaffected by it. So much so that NBA star Steven Adams has claimed that he expects the launch of Rockstar’s latest to lead to a “league-wide” drop in performance for basketball players and coaches .
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》将于11月19日推出，届时似乎会席卷全球，体育和娱乐界也难免受到影响。NBA球星Steven Adams甚至表示，他预计Rockstar这部新作发售后，整个联盟的球员和教练表现都会下滑。

paragraphs.en: It’s already been a busy week for the GTA and Red Dead Redemption studio, as we imagine every week will be from now until the release of GTA 6. The developer has taken down footage of scrapped GTA 5 DLC and an early version of a leaked GTA 6 map , and has outlined its new modding policy , as dreams of monetized GTA 6 RP servers appear to have been dashed.
paragraphs.cn: 对开发《GTA》和《荒野大镖客：救赎》的Rockstar来说，这一周已经够忙了；我们猜，从现在到《GTA6》发售，每周恐怕都会如此。Rockstar已要求下架被取消的《GTA5》DLC画面，以及泄露的早期版本《GTA6》地图，并公布了新的模组政策。看来，靠《GTA6》角色扮演服务器赚钱的愿望也落空了。
